description: This file defines the RevokeAuthenticationEvents class, which extends CookieAuthenticationEvents to implement custom validation logic for cookie-based authentication. It checks if a user's authentication has been revoked by consulting a cache and, if so, logs out the user.

classes.name: RevokeAuthenticationEvents
classes.description: Custom implementation of CookieAuthenticationEvents that revokes user authentication based on cache entries.

methods.name: ValidatePrincipal
methods.description: Override that validates the user principal; if revoked, it logs out the user.
